ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible area, bordered by low-intensity (black) pigment along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zone across both lobes. Low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge. Distinct small black focal blobs are located on the interior surface: one near the median notch on the left lobe, and two small circular points on the right lobe. Yellowish-tan chromatic variance is visible at the lower-central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; internal angle estimated at 65 degrees; notch depth is approximately 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge. Peaks are irregular with pixel amplitudes varying from small ripples to distinct jagged projections, particularly prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that exhibit an upward and outward sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, high-contrast textured clusters located at both the left and right distal tips. Isolated dark circular pixel clusters (potential scarring) are visible on the interior white surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned yellowish linear streaks are detectable in the lower-central region near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue deformation and dark textured clusters (barnacle colonization points) at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-orange pigmentation/staining concentrated at the peduncle junction and radiating towards the mid-section of both lobes.
